# PR Reviews

When doing a PR review and you find a change that needs to be made. Invoke Kelos Operator with "/iterate" in the PR comment (ensure the comment only contains the keyword and nothing else and it is not a comment that has to be resolved. Needs to be a regular comment) but if nothing is wrong add "/ready-check" instead. we are using https://github.com/kelos-dev/kelos to automate this repo further.
